parameters.query:
WITH current_report AS (
    -- 1. Get the GPS coordinates of the new report coming from n8n
    SELECT id, latitude, longitude
    FROM reports 
    WHERE id::text = '{{ $json.body.record.report_id }}'::text
),
nearby_je AS (
    -- 2. SPATIAL GROUPING: Is a JE already working within 200 meters?
    SELECT f.id::text AS worker_id
    FROM work_orders w
    JOIN reports r ON w.report_id::text = r.id::text
    JOIN field_workers f ON w.worker_id::text = f.id::text
    JOIN current_report cr ON true
    WHERE w.status = 'Pending'
      AND w.report_id::text != cr.id::text
      AND f.department_id::text = '{{ $json.body.record.department_id }}'::text
      AND f.hierarchy_level = 2 -- JEs are now Level 2!
      -- PostGIS math: 200 meter radius
      AND ST_DWithin(
            ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(r.longitude, r.latitude), 4326)::geography,
            ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(cr.longitude, cr.latitude), 4326)::geography,
            200
          )
    LIMIT 1
),
workloads AS (
    -- 3. YOUR LOAD BALANCING: Calculate the total effort score for all JEs in this department
    SELECT 
        f.id::text AS worker_id, 
        f.worker_name, 
        f.email AS worker_email,
        COALESCE(SUM(ic.effort_weight), 0) AS total_effort_score,
        f.last_assigned_at
    FROM field_workers f
    LEFT JOIN work_orders w ON f.id::text = w.worker_id::text AND w.status = 'Pending'
    LEFT JOIN reports r ON w.report_id::text = r.id::text
    LEFT JOIN issue_categories ic ON r.issue_type = ic.category_name
    WHERE f.department_id::text = '{{ $json.body.record.department_id }}'::text
      AND f.hierarchy_level = 2 -- Updated to Level 2
    GROUP BY f.id, f.worker_name, f.email, f.last_assigned_at
)
-- 4. THE DECISION ENGINE
SELECT 
    w.worker_id, 
    w.worker_name, 
    w.worker_email,
    w.total_effort_score,
    (SELECT issue_type FROM reports WHERE id::text = '{{ $json.body.record.report_id }}'::text) AS issue_type,
    -- Tells n8n if this was assigned based on location or effort!
    (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN true ELSE false END FROM nearby_je) AS is_grouped_assignment
FROM workloads w
ORDER BY 
    -- PRIORITY 1: If a JE is working nearby, force them to the top of the list!
    CASE WHEN w.worker_id IN (SELECT worker_id FROM nearby_je) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC,
    
    -- PRIORITY 2: Otherwise, give it to the JE with the lowest Effort Score
    w.total_effort_score ASC,
    
    -- PRIORITY 3: Tie-breaker - Give it to whoever hasn't been assigned a ticket recently
    w.last_assigned_at ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE field_workers 
SET last_assigned_at = NOW() 
WHERE id = '{{ $json["worker_id"] }}'
RETURNING id AS worker_id, worker_name, email AS worker_email;
